rounds.text: Laxmipati Engineering Works Ltd trades at an extremely compelling valuation, featuring a P/E ratio of just 9.6x against a sector benchmark of 25.13x [E5]. This discount is paired with blistering operational momentum, highlighted by recent sales surging 91% year-on-year [E61] and a 3-year compounded profit growth of 22% [E18]. Profitability metrics also flash major brilliance in asset efficiency, boasting an exceptional return on assets (ROA) of 50.46% compared to a sector benchmark of a mere 4.32% [E7]. Furthermore, the business is aggressively reinvesting into its future, demonstrated by a capital work-in-progress (CWIP) expansion to Rs 7 Cr for March 2026, representing a massive 250% increase over the prior year [E37]. Conceded: the price-to-book ratio is elevated at 8.08x [E1], and the trailing twelve months have recorded a profit contraction of -112% [E19].
